parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object('total_contacts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE is_archived = false), 'open_deals', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open'), 'total_revenue', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Won'), 'tasks_due_today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND is_completed = false AND due_at::date = CURRENT_DATE), 'tasks_overdue', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND is_completed = false AND due_at < now()), 'team_members', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE active = true), 'new_contacts_today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE), 'pipeline_by_stage', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('stage_name', st.name, 'count', COALESCE(o.cnt, 0)) ORDER BY st.display_order), '[]'::json) FROM stages st LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Open' GROUP BY stage_id) o ON o.stage_id = st.id WHERE st.name NOT ILIKE '%won%' AND st.name NOT ILIKE '%lost%'), 'lead_sources', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('lead_source', COALESCE(lead_source, 'Unknown'), 'count', cnt)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT lead_source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM contacts WHERE is_archived = false GROUP BY lead_source ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) s), 'upcoming_tasks', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'subject', subject, 'due_at', due_at)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, subject, due_at FROM activities WHERE type = 'task' AND is_completed = false AND due_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY due_at ASC LIMIT 5) t), 'recent_activities', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'description', description, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT a.id, (COALESCE(u.name, 'Someone') || ' logged a ' || a.type || ': ' || COALESCE(a.subject, '(no subject)')) AS description, a.created_at FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) r), 'recent_contacts', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'lead_status', lead_status, 'owner_name', owner_name, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.id, TRIM(CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name)) AS name, c.lead_status, u.name AS owner_name, c.created_at FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.is_archived = false ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) rc)) AS result;
